'''Philippe Gabriel Michel''' (born 23 January 1969) is a French mathematician who holds the chair in [[analytic number theory]] at the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] in Switzerland.<ref name="cv">[http://www.ae-info.org/attach/User/Michel_Philippe/CV/curriculum.pdf Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2015-01-23.</ref>

== Early life, education and career ==
Michel was born in [[Lyon]]. He studied from 1989 to 1993 at the [[École normale supérieure de Cachan]], and then moved to the [[University of Paris-Sud]], where he earned a doctorate in 1995 under the supervision of [[Étienne Fouvry]] and then a [[habilitation]] in 1998.<ref name="cv"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=64247}}</ref> He was a professor at the [[University of Montpellier]] from 1998 to 2008, when he moved to EPFL.<ref name="cv"/>

==Recognition==
In 1999, Michel was awarded the Peccot-Vimont Prize<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.college-de-france.fr/media/cours-peccot/UPL4417563382308777062_LISTE_DES_LAUREATS_DU_PRIX_PECCOT_VIMONT_DEPUIS_1885.pdf|title=Liste des laureats du prix Peccot-Vimont depuis 1885|publisher=College de France|access-date=2024-04-12}}</ref> and gave the [[Peccot Lectures|Peccot Lecture]] at the Collège de France.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.college-de-france.fr/media/cours-peccot/UPL1466994975427365342_LISTE_CHRONOLOGIQUE_DES_INTITULES_DES_COURS_PECCOT_DEPUIS_1899_.pdf|title=Liste chronologique des cours Peccot avec les intitulés depuis 1899|publisher=College de France|access-date=2024-04-12}}</ref>
In 2006, he was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>{{citation
 | last1 = Michel | first1 = Philippe G.
 | last2 = Venkatesh | first2 = Akshay
 | contribution = Equidistribution, ''L''-functions and ergodic theory: on some problems of Yu. Linnik
 | mr = 2275604
 | pages = 421–457
 | publisher = Eur. Math. Soc., Zürich
 | title = International Congress of Mathematicians. Vol. II
 | year = 2006}}.</ref><ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |date=2017-11-24 }}, [[International Mathematical Union]], retrieved 2015-01-23.</ref>
In 2011, he was elected to the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref>[http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Michel_Philippe Member profile], [[Academia Europaea]], retrieved 2015-01-23.</ref>
In 2012, he became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-01-23.</ref>
